nodes.name: Chemical deposition of B-CoO_x
nodes.procedure: The B-CoO_x electrode was fabricated via a chemical deposition process. A 30 mL aqueous solution containing a piece of NF pretreated with acetone and dilute hydrochloric acid, 70 mM Co(NO3)2·6H2O, 400 mM NH4F, and 4.0 mL of 32 wt% ammonium was deoxygenated and then saturated with argon gas, denoted as Solution A. Concurrently, a 30 mL aqueous solution comprising 500 mM NaBH4 and 75 mM NaOH was also deoxygenated and saturated with argon, labeled as Solution B. Under ultrasonication, Solution B was incrementally titrated into Solution A. Upon completion of the reaction, the NF was thoroughly rinsed with distilled water and subsequently dried under vacuum at 60°C. The resultant specimen was designated as B-CoO_x.

nodes.name: Phosphorization of B-CoO_x to B-Co_xP
nodes.procedure: The B-Co_xP electrode was synthesized via a calcination method. Initially, a porcelain boat containing B-CoO_x was placed downstream within a tubular furnace. Subsequently, another porcelain boat laden with 0.25 g of NaH2PO2 was positioned upstream within the same furnace. Ultimately, the system was subjected to calcination at 350°C under an argon atmosphere for 2 h, and the resulting catalyst was denoted as B-Co_xP.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images reveal flower-like morphology of CoBO_x precursor composed of adhesive nanosheets with uniform radius of approximately 100 nm, and B-Co_xP catalysts have high permeability and interconnected three-dimensional multichannel structures.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images (Figure 1B,C) reveal a flower-like morphology of the precursor composed of adhesive nanosheets with a uniform radius of approximately 100 nm. Figure 1E,F shows that the B - Co_xP catalysts have high permeability and interconnected three-dimensional multichannel structures...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows CoBO_x exhibits amorphous characteristic; B-Co_xP shows multilayered ultrathin nanosheets with lattice fringes of 1.9 Å and 1.7 Å for Co2P (211) and (103) planes, 2.2 Å for CoP (121) plane, indicating heterojunctions between CoP and Co2P phases; significant strain at heterojunction interface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) image and selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns (Figure 1D) indicate that CoBO_x exhibits an amorphous characteristic... The HRTEM image shows the multilayered morphology of the B - Co_xP ultrathin nanosheets (Figure S5), and distinct lattice fringes with interplanar spacings of 1.9 and 1.7Å for the (211) and (103) planes of C o2P , respectively, and 2.2Å for the (121) plane of CoP (Figure 1G)...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM and elemental mapping show Co, P, and B uniformly distributed on B-Co_xP sheets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM image of the B - Co_xP composite and elemental mapping images for (I) Co, (J) P, and (K) B... Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) line scans (Figure 1H) and EDS mapping analysis (Figure 1I-K) show that Co, P, and B are uniformly distributed on the sheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms formation of B-Co_xP with peaks corresponding to Co2P (PDF#32-0306) and CoP (PDF#29-0497) phases; low-angle shift confirms B doping; shift towards higher angles indicates lattice strain.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD patterns (Figure 2A) confirm the successful formation B - C o_xP (with peaks corresponding to Co_2P : PDF#32-0306 and CoP: PDF#29-0497 phases). A low-angle shift in characteristic peaks of B - C o_xP in XRD confirms B doping.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman spectrum of B-Co_xP exhibits peaks at 470, 510, 600, and 676 cm⁻¹ corresponding to Eg, F2g, and A1g modes of Co-P bonding; changes in peak intensity and positions due to B doping and phase ratio effects.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectrum of B - C o_xP exhibits four distinct peaks at 470, 510, 600, and 676 cm⁻¹ , corresponding to the characteristic vibrational modes E_g (470 cm⁻¹ ) , F_{2g} (510 and 600 cm⁻¹ ) , and A_{1g} (676 cm⁻¹ ) which are associated with Co - P bonding.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p XPS shows peaks at 783.6/799.1 eV (Co²⁺ oxidized), 779.9/795.05 eV (Co-P); B 1s at 187.8 eV (Co-B), 192.5 eV (B-O); P 2p at 129.6/128.9 eV (Co-P), 133.5 eV (P-O); peak shifts confirm B doping effects and phase transitions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution Co 2p XPS spectra of B - Co_xP at various phosphorization stages (Figure 2C) indicated peaks at 783.6 and 799.1 eV for Co2p_{3/2} ... B 1s spectra of the B- Co_xP peaks occurring at 187.8 and 192.5 eV are attributed to Co-B and B-O bonds... The P 2p spectra (Figure 2E) show peaks of 129.6 eV (2p_{1/2}) and 128.9 eV (2p_{3/2}) for the Co-P bond...

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge XANES shows absorption edge of B-Co_xP between Co2P and CoP, indicating electron transfer; higher than Co2P but lower than Co3O4, suggesting electronic interaction and slightly oxidized Co.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) was utilized to probe their electronic structures... the XANES spectra of B - C o_xP showed an absorption edge between Co_2P and CoP , indicating electron transfer from Co_2P to CoP.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge EXAFS shows major peak at 1.98 Å between Co-P (1.74 Å) and Co-Co (2.34 Å); WT-EXAFS shows intense signal at 6.8 Å⁻¹ for Co-P bond and enhanced Co-Co bonding.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) at the Co K-edge... B - C o_xP shows a major peak (1.98 Å) in R-space between Co - P (1.74 Å) and Co - Co (2.34 Å)... High-resolution wavelet-transform EXAFS (WT-EXAFS) of the Co K-edge reveals the highly dispersed state of B - C o_xP.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ XRD shows B-Co_xP crystal structure remains unchanged under positive and negative voltages in alkaline electrolyte.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ XRD and Raman spectroscopy measurements were conducted... Figure 3G,H shows that the B - C o_xP crystal structure remains unchanged under positive and negative voltages in an alkaline electrolyte.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows Co(OH)2 peak at 689 cm⁻¹ during HER; CoOOH peaks at 503 and 587 cm⁻¹ during OER; no permanent CoOOH phase after reaction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman spectroscopy provides direct observation... a weak characteristic peak at 689 cm⁻¹ , attributed to Co(OH)_2 , is observed. Additionally, the emergence of CoOOH is evident at 503 and 587 cm⁻¹ after the initiation of the OER reaction.

nodes.characterization_summary: CV scans at varying scan rates (20-100 mV/s) used to calculate double-layer capacitance Cdl; B-Co_xP exhibits the largest Cdl and highest ECSA among samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The C_dl of the catalysts was deduced from CV scans with sweep rates varying from 20 to 100 mV⋅s⁻¹. Notably, the B - Co_xP catalyst exhibited... the largest electrochemical C_dl , indicating... the highest ECSA (Figure 3C and Figures S15 and S10).
